page.notes: Long s is printed as a plain s throughout. The abbreviation marks after "quaq", "illorūq", "earumq" and "eorumq" are a small figure 3-like sign; I could not confirm their exact expansion, so they are marked [?]. The initial "F" of "Fœdera" is a large joined letter, read here as "FEdera". The running head "INDEX" is set in spaced capitals. No page number is printed on this page. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is left out.
